About the Talk:

The success of any AI application today relies on the quality of a model's training data —and for 95% of teams, this essential step is both the most costly, and the most time-consuming, in getting their product to market. Encord is a multimodal data development platform, focusing on data management, curation, annotation & model observability in a single platform - supporting Images, Text, Documents, Video & Audio. This talk will explore how AI teams can reduce human workloads through intelligent curation techniques including embeddings & semantic searches, as well as leveraging state-of-the-art AI models to efficiently produce high-quality multimodal training datasets at scale. We will also discuss steps enterprises can take to ensure annotation quality, particularly when leveraging external annotation teams.

About the Speaker :

Alexandre Bonnet is the Machine Learning Solutions Engineer Lead at Encord. He holds a Master’s degree in Theoretical Physics from Imperial College and has been a Senior Data Engineer in various AI companies. Alexandre has also been a member of Entrepreneur First’s LD17 cohort as the CTO and Co-Founder of a funded insurtech venture. He will be giving the presentation jointly with Alexandre Winstone, Account Director at Encord, who holds a degree in Philosophy, Politics, and Economics from Exeter University, and has over five years experience working in AI, including 4 years founding and leading the commercial team at causaLens.
